description:
Texas added more people than any other state last year. No state income tax. Jobs everywhere. But behind the headlines, listings just hit 123,000 statewide — 53% higher than normal. Texas is now the fourth most oversupplied housing market in the entire country. And in some cities, home prices are in freefall.
In this video we count down 10 Texas cities where home prices are crashing right now based on the latest data from Zillow, Redfin, Reventure App, and the Texas Real Estate Research Center.
From the oil fields of West Texas to the tech corridors of Austin to the suburbs of Houston and Dallas — this is the data that sellers do not want you to see and buyers need to know.
fulltitle: 10 Texas Cities Where Home Prices Are Crashing Right Now (2026)
